# 為了用ai來幫助我開發mvp，開始學shema怎麼寫

以下是ai payment的shema草稿

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", //寫定規範
  "$id": "https://example.local/agentpay/payment-plan.schema.json",
  "title": "AgentPay Payment Plan",
  "description": "A structured payment intent generated by an AI agent before wallet execution.",
  "type": "object",在javascript裡的物件，可以用JSON0.parse(物件)來解析物件
                                         //可在console.log(jsonObj.name);
                                          來執行物件
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "taskId",
    "userIntent",
    "chain",
    "asset",
    "recipient",
    "amount",
    "riskControls",
    "approvalMode"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "taskId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "description": "Stable ID for the user task."
    },
    "userIntent": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 10,
      "description": "Plain-language summary of what the user asked the agent to do."
    },
    "chain": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["name", "chainId", "networkType"],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["base", "base-sepolia", "ethereum", "ethereum-sepolia"]
        },
        "chainId": {
          "type": "integer",
          "enum": [8453, 84532, 1, 11155111]
        },
        "networkType": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["mainnet", "testnet"]
        }
      }
    },
    "asset": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["symbol", "type"],
      "properties": {
        "symbol": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["ETH", "USDC"]
        },
        "type": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["native", "erc20"]
        },
        "contractAddress": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$"
        },
        "decimals": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 36
        }
      }
    },
    "recipient": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["address", "label", "allowlistStatus"],
      "properties": {
        "address": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$"
        },
        "label": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "allowlistStatus": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["allowed", "unknown", "blocked"]
        }
      }
    },
    "amount": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["value", "unit"],
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\\.[0-9]+)?$"
        },
        "unit": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["ETH", "USDC"]
        },
        "estimatedUsd": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\\.[0-9]+)?$"
        }
      }
    },
    "riskControls": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["maxSinglePaymentUsd", "maxDailySpendUsd", "requiresAllowlistedRecipient"],
      "properties": {
        "maxSinglePaymentUsd": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\\.[0-9]+)?$"
        },
        "maxDailySpendUsd": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\\.[0-9]+)?$"
        },
        "requiresAllowlistedRecipient": {
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "denyIfMainnet": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "For learning mode, deny all mainnet payments."
        }
      }
    },
    "approvalMode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["auto-allow", "require-human-review", "deny"]
    },
    "notes": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}

```
